verdict.rationale: The evidence shows EBANX offers dashboard-created payment links and a hosted checkout page. These are related payment-collection features, not hosted invoices, and nothing in the pack documents invoice documents or automatic payment reminders. The axis applies to a payments platform, so the lack of an invoicing capability is "none" rather than "na".

support.subject: As a finance-ops user, I can send hosted invoices with online payment and automatic reminders
